model.description: Sugaree's Gelato 1g cartridge delivers a premium indica experience in a convenient distillate format. As an indica-dominant option, it promotes deep relaxation and tranquility, making it ideal for unwinding after a long day or easing into restful sleep. The distillate formulation ensures consistent potency and clean vapor with every draw, while the 510 thread compatibility fits most standard batteries for on-the-go convenience. Gelato's balanced effects may also spark euphoria and happiness alongside its calming properties. Perfect for evening use or anytime you need to melt away stress and tension. Sugaree brings quality craftsmanship to this beloved strain, offering a flavorful and reliable cartridge experience.
